name: datadog-code-analysis
description: Surfaces Datadog best practices and telemetry guidance at coding time, so your agent considers observability from the start.

dd_site.title: Datadog site
dd_site.description: Your organization's Datadog site -- see the "Site Parameter" field at https://docs.datadoghq.com/getting_started/site/#access-the-datadog-site (e.g. datadoghq.com, datadoghq.eu).

dd_api_key.title: Datadog API key
dd_api_key.description: Identifies your Datadog organization and authenticates API requests.

dd_app_key.title: Datadog Application key
dd_app_key.description: Used together with the API key to authenticate programmatic API access.

enable_on_commit_telemetry_review.title: Enable on-commit telemetry review
enable_on_commit_telemetry_review.description: Run an agentic telemetry review after commits, checking the diff for observability gaps or violations of best practices. Findings are surfaced back into your session.

enable_datadog_resource_suggestions.title: Enable Datadog resource suggestions
enable_datadog_resource_suggestions.description: After commits, nudge the agent to consider suggesting relevant Datadog resource creation
